events.title: England clinch the Home Championship by beating Scotland 2–0 at Wembley. 19-year-old 스윈던 타운 striker Paul Rideout moves from the Fourth Division to the First in a £200,000 transfer to 애스턴 빌라.

Resurgent 포츠머스 , newly promoted to the Second Division after winning last season's Third Division title, prepare for their latest challenge by paying a club record £180,000 for 코번트리 시티 's 21-year-old striker Mark Hateley .
Billy McNeill steps down as manager of Scottish league champions 셀틱 to take over as manager of 맨체스터 시티.
